entry.title: Introduce LearnWithNoura with a reproducible public developer workflow
entry.content:
Introduce LearnWithNoura with a reproducible public developer workflow

Align the package, page, manifest and version endpoint with LearnWithNoura while preserving the tutor persona and existing data namespaces. Explain the runtime, contribution history, experiments and readiness limits in the README. Make the example environment offline by default, remove hidden provider-key dependencies from preparation tests, include inspected home snapshots, and add clean-checkout CI.

entry.title: Reject invalid deployment modes instead of bypassing production guards
entry.content:
Reject invalid deployment modes instead of bypassing production guards

A misspelled mode previously fell back to local synthetic behavior, even on a production host. Fail startup on invalid modes and require production signing secrets to contain at least 32 characters.

entry.title: Update the query parser to address denial-of-service advisories
entry.content:
Update the query parser to address denial-of-service advisories

Refresh qs from 6.15.3 to 6.16.0 within the existing dependency constraints. A clean npm install and production dependency audit now report zero known vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Dispose work that arrives after a tutor generation has ended
entry.content:
Dispose work that arrives after a tutor generation has ended

Late async continuations could attach intervals and cleanup callbacks to an inactive scope forever. Refuse new scheduling and dispose late resources immediately after cancellation, failure, or completion.

entry.title: Preserve database certificate verification when parsing connection URLs
entry.content:
Preserve database certificate verification when parsing connection URLs

node-postgres can replace explicit TLS options with URL query settings. Strip those competing settings before pool creation and accept a configured PEM CA so managed databases can verify their certificate chain without disabling TLS verification.

entry.title: Include synthetic image evidence required by the offline test suite
entry.content:
Include synthetic image evidence required by the offline test suite

Fresh clones were missing 53 screenshots referenced by retained M2, M3 and M7 verifiers. Add the original inspected images without altering their hashes or historic acceptance decisions; all other generated artifacts remain ignored.

entry.title: Bound request throttling and reject malformed authentication input
entry.content:
Bound request throttling and reject malformed authentication input

Handle malformed cookie encoding without failing requests, validate signed claim types and token framing, and cap distinct rate-limit keys. Periodic expiry sweeps avoid per-request scans; saturation rejects new keys while preserving active counters.
